en.title: Variety reviews How to Rob a Bank starring Nicholas Hoult and Zoë Kravitz
en.dek: Variety reviewed the Amazon-backed heist film How to Rob a Bank on 12 November 2026
facts: Variety published a review of How to Rob a Bank on 12 November 2026
Nicholas Hoult plays Ryan, leader of the anonymous bank-robbing crew
Zoë Kravitz plays Raegan, a tech-wiz recruited by FBI agent John West
The film was directed by David Leitch
body: Variety reported that How to Rob a Bank is an Amazon-backed heist film directed by David Leitch. The review describes the film as an awkwardly ineffective actioner about a team of revolutionary bank robbers.
The crew posts YouTube-esque explainer videos featuring wolf masks that detail bank robbing tricks to online followers, using pop-up graphics over Go-Pro-esque footage of their exploits.
en.context: The film stars Nicholas Hoult as Ryan and Zoë Kravitz as Raegan, and was directed by David Leitch.
